_comment: AWS's P-EAGLE drafters (arXiv 2602.01469): EAGLE-3 trained to draft every token of a step in one forward, its rows past the newest reading learned placeholders (the `ptd_token_id` token's embedding and `mask_hidden`, which vLLM's `parallel_drafting` loads the same way). It ships as its own checkpoint with its own config, whose `architectures` reads `LlamaForCausalLM`, so it names its target configs (`head_targets`): 20B's drafter (`amazon/GPT-OSS-20B-P-EAGLE`) gpt-oss-20b, 120B's (`amazon/gpt-oss-120b-p-eagle`: an 11520-wide MLP, and attention biases, `attention_bias_layers`) gpt-oss-120b under its quant presets and the self-contained gpt-oss-120b-3bit, which share its shape; the two drafters' configs differ only where their weights' shapes do, which is how a checkpoint finds its variant. It drafts only when `--speculative-model` names a checkpoint of it (`spec/mtp` compiles it). It reads its target's residual stream entering three of its layers, which its config names in `eagle_config` or, naming none (AWS's do not), vLLM's EAGLE-3 default from its target's layer count (`target_capture_default`: (2, 12, 21) of gpt-oss-20b's 24, (2, 18, 33) of 120B's 36). Its tensors sit at the file's top level (`decoder_safetensors_prefix` empty): its first layer as `midlayer.*`, the rest as `layers.<L>.*`. It borrows only its target's lm_head (`borrows`): AWS froze it in training, so the drafter's own copy is the target's bit for bit; its embedding it trained, so that one is its own. It drafts over its target vocabulary's first 65536 ids (`vocab_size`, the lm_head rows it reads), as Qwen3.5's head does; its embedding keeps every id (`embed_vocab_size`), the mask token's (201020) among them. `backbone_hidden_size` is the width of the three target hidden states `fc` fuses.
